title: A beautiful village square with a functioning bakery
experience: Walk from the settlement stone through a coherent village square; see farming, deliveries, baking and meals change citizens' lives and the appearance of their workplaces.

stages.goal: Finish a coherent stone-to-square approach with readable paths, grounded architecture, restrained planting and consistent lighting and materials.
acceptance: Noticeable improvement from the opening and village walking views
Clear path and usable entrances with no new collisions
Consistent materials and vegetation; no density for its own sake

stages.goal: Build and integrate a deterministic farming-to-bakery-to-meals chain with inventories and visible consequences.
acceptance: Supply changes bread production and meals
Resource balances remain nonnegative and deterministic over long runs
The running settlement invokes the system and exposes its result; a disconnected module is unfinished

stages.goal: Show deliveries, baking, meals and progressive workshop furnishing in the polished square.
acceptance: Visible activity reflects actual simulation facts
A returning player can see construction or provisioning progress
Citizens can reach destinations and finish tasks without jitter or deadlock

stages.goal: Make weather influence food production, shelter use and work, with visible readable consequences.
acceptance: Weather has deterministic consequences for an existing supply chain
Citizens can reach shelter and resume work
Weather presentation preserves route readability and performance

stages.goal: Connect several workplaces through inventories, transport capacity and shortages.
acceptance: Resources move between actual workplaces without duplication
Shortages cause recoverable changes in work priorities
Long runs remain deterministic and bounded

stages.goal: Give citizens persistent households, routines and useful belongings supported by the economy.
acceptance: Owned furnishings and household provisioning have visible persistent state
Routines respond to work and basic needs
No session data is used and navigation remains reliable

artStandard: Preserve landmark silhouettes and intentional open space
Use one coherent stone, wood and foliage palette
Windows share typography, spacing, icons and dismissal behavior
constraints: Original code and existing CC0 assets only
Do not touch private session data or the separate Arcus product
Performance and behavioral gates remain immutable to generated changes
